export type CorpusDocument = CorpusItemRevision | DiscoveryPath | CorpusDecision;
export const CORPUS_MEMBERSHIP_SCHEMA_SHA256 = "@@SCHEMA_SHA256@@";

const SCHEMA: unknown = @@SCHEMA_JSON@@;
type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>;
const FORBIDDEN = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"]);

function record(value: unknown): JsonRecord | null {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) return null;
  const descriptors = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(value);
  if (Object.keys(descriptors).length > 32 || Object.entries(descriptors).some(([key, property]) =>
    FORBIDDEN.has(key) || !("value" in property))) return null;
  return value as JsonRecord;
}

function matches(value: unknown, rawNode: unknown, depth = 0): boolean {
  if (depth > 12) return false;
  const node = record(rawNode);
  const definitions = record(record(SCHEMA)?.$defs);
  if (!node || !definitions) return false;
  if (typeof node.$ref === "string") {
    const name = node.$ref.startsWith("#/$defs/") ? node.$ref.slice(8) : "";
    return name !== "" && matches(value, definitions[name], depth + 1);
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(node, "const") && value !== node.const) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum) && !node.enum.includes(value)) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.anyOf) && !node.anyOf.some((option) => matches(value, option, depth + 1))) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(node.oneOf) && node.oneOf.filter((option) => matches(value, option, depth + 1)).length !== 1) return false;
  if (node.type === "null") return value === null;
  if (node.type === "string") {
    if (typeof value !== "string") return false;
    const length = Array.from(value).length;
    if (length > 256) return false;
    if (typeof node.minLength === "number" && length < node.minLength) return false;
    if (typeof node.maxLength === "number" && length > node.maxLength) return false;
    if (typeof node.pattern === "string" && !new RegExp(node.pattern, "u").test(value)) return false;
  }
  if (node.type === "integer") {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value)) return false;
    if (typeof node.minimum === "number" && (value as number) < node.minimum) return false;
    if (typeof node.maximum === "number" && (value as number) > node.maximum) return false;
  }
  if (node.type === "array") {
    if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > 1000) return false;
    if (typeof node.minItems === "number" && value.length < node.minItems) return false;
    if (typeof node.maxItems === "number" && value.length > node.maxItems) return false;
    if (!value.every((item) => matches(item, node.items, depth + 1))) return false;
  }
  if (node.type === "object") {
    const item = record(value);
    const properties = record(node.properties);
    if (!item || !properties || !Array.isArray(node.required)) return false;
    const keys = Object.keys(item);
    if (node.additionalProperties === false && keys.some((key) => !Object.hasOwn(properties, key))) return false;
    if (!node.required.every((key) => typeof key === "string" && Object.hasOwn(item, key))) return false;
    if (!keys.every((key) => matches(item[key], properties[key], depth + 1))) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function sortedUnique(values: unknown): boolean {
  return Array.isArray(values) && values.every((value, index) =>
    typeof value === "string" && (index === 0 || values[index - 1] < value));
}

function canonicalUtcMillis(value: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof value === "string" && !value.startsWith("0000")
    && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) && new Date(value).toISOString() === value;
}

function semanticError(document: JsonRecord): string | null {
  if (document.documentType === "research-observatory-corpus-item-revision") {
    if (document.itemId === document.revisionId || document.itemId === document.workId
      || document.previousRevisionId === document.revisionId) return "corpus-item-identity-invalid";
    if (document.duplicateOfItemId === document.itemId) return "corpus-duplicate-self-invalid";
    if (!sortedUnique(document.discoveryPathIds)) return "corpus-discovery-paths-invalid";
    if (document.previousRevisionId === null &&
      (document.membership !== "candidate" || document.review !== "pending"
        || document.duplicateOfItemId !== null || document.availability !== "unknown"
        || document.decisionRevisionId !== null)) return "corpus-initial-state-invalid";
    if (document.previousRevisionId !== null && document.decisionRevisionId === null) return "corpus-decision-required";
    return null;
  }
  if (document.documentType === "research-observatory-discovery-path") {
    if (document.pathId === document.itemId || document.sourceRevisionId === document.pathId
      || document.predecessorItemRevisionId === document.itemId
      || document.predecessorItemRevisionId === document.pathId) return "corpus-discovery-identity-invalid";
    if (!canonicalUtcMillis(document.occurredAt)) return "corpus-discovery-time-invalid";
    const typed = [document.queryRevisionId, document.citingWorkRevisionId,
      document.recommendationRevisionId, document.manualDecisionRevisionId];
    if (document.kind === "import-member") {
      return typeof document.ordinal === "number" && document.ordinal >= 1
        && typeof document.recordKeySha256 === "string" && typed.every((value) => value === null)
        ? null : "corpus-import-path-invalid";
    }
    if (document.kind === "connector-record") {
      return typeof document.ordinal === "number" && document.ordinal <= 999
        && document.recordKeySha256 === null && document.queryRevisionId !== null
        && typed.slice(1).every((value) => value === null) ? null : "corpus-connector-path-invalid";
    }
    const expected = document.kind === "citation" ? document.citingWorkRevisionId
      : document.kind === "recommendation" ? document.recommendationRevisionId
        : document.manualDecisionRevisionId;
    return document.ordinal === null && document.recordKeySha256 === null
      && expected !== null && typed.filter((value) => value !== null).length === 1
      ? null : "corpus-discovery-path-invalid";
  }
  if (document.documentType === "research-observatory-corpus-decision") {
    if (document.previousRevisionId === document.nextRevisionId || [document.itemId,
      document.previousRevisionId, document.nextRevisionId].includes(document.decisionId)) return "corpus-decision-identity-invalid";
    if (!sortedUnique(document.evidenceRevisionIds)) return "corpus-decision-evidence-invalid";
    if (document.previousValue === document.nextValue) return "corpus-decision-no-change";
    if (document.previousDecisionRevisionId === document.decisionId
      || document.supersedesDecisionRevisionId === document.decisionId) return "corpus-decision-self-supersession";
    if ((document.nextWorkId !== null) !== (document.dimension === "work-reference")) return "corpus-decision-work-target-invalid";
    if (!canonicalUtcMillis(document.occurredAt)) return "corpus-decision-time-invalid";
    return null;
  }
  return "corpus-document-type-invalid";
}

export function corpusContractErrors(value: unknown): ReadonlyArray<string> {
  try {
    if (!matches(value, SCHEMA)) return Object.freeze(["corpus-contract-schema-invalid"]);
    const error = semanticError(value as JsonRecord);
    return Object.freeze(error === null ? [] : [error]);
  } catch {
    return Object.freeze(["corpus-contract-schema-invalid"]);
  }
}

export function decodeCorpusDocument(value: unknown): CorpusDocument | null {
  if (corpusContractErrors(value).length !== 0) return null;
  try {
    const owned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as CorpusDocument;
    if (corpusContractErrors(owned).length !== 0) return null;
    const freeze = (item: unknown): void => {
      if (item !== null && typeof item === "object") {
        Object.values(item).forEach(freeze);
        Object.freeze(item);
      }
    };
    freeze(owned);
    return owned;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
